summary_md: **John T Davies 🇪🇺 ([@jtdavies](https://x.com/jtdavies/status/2115786207133147399))** had Claude benchmark **TandemLLM v0.15.0** serving Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a DGX Spark: it led for single users with small prompts (about 60–67 tok/s at 1k–16k), was weaker on long prompts and concurrency (74 tok/s for eight 2k chats vs. 105 for TensorFold 1.1.7), and excelled at resuming conversations (a 97k chat back in 7.5 s vs. 44 s) ([0xBakeer/TandemLLM](https://github.com/0xBakeer/TandemLLM), [hle-lite](https://github.com/Incept5-AI/hle-lite)).
